In order to do that you need to install the Yacy software and start indexing some websites and keep the software open as much as possible so it can get accessed by the rest of the peers.

If you're unfamiliar with decentralized networks the idea is there's no single point of failure. All computers interacting are equally important. If one goes down your requests go through a different computer (or sets of computers). It's where we're trying to go in many areas (Bitcoin, etc.) but doing it right is difficult as fuck.

The thing with these decentralized networks is they're very difficult to properly monetize. It would help loads if people started donating or contributing code for these projects.
